name: Airo Health
long_description:
Airo Health is a fast growing Y Combinator-funded company building a next generation armband that has changed people think about their health. We are a multidisciplinary team that brings together expertise in biomedical engineering, user experience, artificial intelligence, software engineering, hardware engineering, and manufacturing.

Mental Health, an issue often neglected, directly affects your overall health, quality of life, and productivity. Airo is your companion through the stressful times. It sits on your arm and automatically tracks when you’re getting anxious and recommends easy tweaks that reduce stress.
one_liner: Airo is an AI wearable to track mental health.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Built wallet products driving $200M+ in transaction volume. Scaled account abstraction to 2.1M agents and humans. Co-founded Airo Health (YC S16) and increased usable ML training data 10×. Deployed a healthcare voice agent, agent harnesses and permission-aware company knowledge systems. Built financial-reconstruction tools and evaluations to test reliability. Waterloo Computer Engineering. San Francisco.
